source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Exact source records mapped to established public labels; mapping is recorded for every verse and verified against source KJV annotations. Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum have chapter-boundary differences.

key_decisions.decision: Preserves the unusual third-person Lord phrase and shining-face image.
Keeps the man designation and offering time; the difficult flight expression receives a note.
Preserves six purposes and the reading-note end-sin sense, with sevens and holy referent explained in notes.
Follows the major Hebrew pause after seven, keeping the two periods distinct and the ruler unnamed.
Retains the indefinite anointed one, deprivation, flood, and ambiguous final referents.
Keeps the unnamed he, literal wing image, and decreed judgment without adding an end-times scheme.
